name: 112 會考模擬二模（文揚 1～4 冊）英語聽力（附聽力稿）
source: 文揚 112 學年九年級第二次國中教育會考模擬測驗（範圍 1～4 冊），答案與解析取自官方題目解說

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
The boy and the girl are hiking on a cloudy day.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：男孩和女孩在陰天去健行，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
The woman is going to make a birthday cake, so she bought some milk, bananas and two boxes of eggs.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：女子將要做生日蛋糕，所以她買了牛奶、香蕉和兩盒蛋，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
The man and the woman are moving the table. The woman is pushing it and the man is pulling it.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：一男一女在搬桌子，女子用手推，男子用拉的，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Excuse me, how often does Bus 234 run?
o: Here it comes. Let’s run to the bus.
It runs from City Park to City Library.
questions.e: 中譯：說話者問234公車多久一班？最合適的回應為每隔20分鐘，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Can I help you paint the walls this afternoon?
o: Wait! The paint is still wet.
No, thanks. I can do it myself.
questions.e: 中譯：說話者說今天下午我可以幫你油漆牆壁嗎？最合適的回應為不用了，謝謝，我可以自己來，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
There are only a few students in the classroom. Where are the others?
questions.e: 中譯：教室裡只有一些學生。說話者問其他的人在哪裡呢？最合適的回應為在操場，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Why did Tina shout at you just now?
o: Oh, then I shouted back to her.
Hmm, I was playing music too loud.
questions.e: 中譯：說話者問為何Tina對你吼叫呢？最合適的回應為嗯，我音樂放太大聲，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Dad and Mom will come home in an hour. Let’s clean up the living room now.
o: Sorry. I’m busy at the moment.
Right, they’re in the living room.
questions.e: 中譯：說話者說爸媽一個小時後會回來，咱們現在把客廳打掃乾淨，最合適的回應為抱歉，我正在忙，選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Did you meet Jason at the train station at 3 p.m.?
o: No, I didn’t. I forgot all about it.
Of course. I’ll be happy to do it.
Well, see you later at the station.
questions.e: 中譯：說話者問你下午三點和Jason在火車站碰面了嗎？最合適的回應為不，沒有。我完全忘了這件事，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How did Linda park her car between the two big cars?
questions.e: 中譯：說話者問Linda如何把車子停在兩部大車中間呢？最合適的回應為她花了些時間，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
My husband doesn’t feel any better after taking the medicine. I’m worried.
o: Don’t worry. He’s feeling much better now.
Don’t be. I think you should take him to another doctor.
The doctor didn’t tell him to take medicine.
questions.e: 中譯：說話者說：我先生吃藥後沒有比較好，很擔心，最合適的回應為不用擔心，我想妳應該帶他換個醫生看，選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: How are the pants, ma’am?
W: Well, I like the color, but look, they’re a little short for me. What do you think?
M: Do you plan to wear these pants to work or for something else?
W: Oh, I’m going to wear them to a good friend’s party next week.
M: Well, then, you’ll need a longer pair of pants. I’ll get another pair in the same color for you. It will only take a moment.
W: OK, I’ll wait.
Q: Who is the man?
questions.e: 女子試穿長褲。男子詢問她新長褲的用途之後，要為她拿取另一款較長的同顏色褲子來，推知男子為店員，選(A)。(B)男服務生、(C)郵差，皆非合適的答案。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: I have a gift for you, dear. Open it.
W: Wow! White strawberries!
M: Yeah, I bought them at a farmer’s market.
W: Thank you. They must be very expensive.
M: Well, white strawberries usually cost four or five times more than red ones.
W: Wow! Is it because they’re a new kind of fruit?
M: You make a good point. What’s more, white strawberries are more difficult to grow than red ones.
W: I see.
Q: What are the man and the woman talking about?
questions.e: 男子送女子在農夫市集買的白色草莓，也指出這品種草莓價格比紅色草莓貴很多的原因，推知他們在談論一種特殊的水果，選(B)。(A)農夫市集、(C)白色草莓受歡迎的原因，皆非合適的答案。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: It’s hot today. Let’s go swimming this afternoon.
W: Sorry, but we can’t.
M: Why not?
W: You know, we’re having a dry year. No swimming pools near our home are open to the public from the end of April.
M: When will they open again?
W: We’ll have to wait until the rainy season.
M: That’s too pathetic.
W: I know. I’d love to swim in cool water, too.
Q: When the man says, “That’s too pathetic,” what does he mean?
questions.e: 天氣熱，男子下午想要游泳，但女子告知他因為今年乾旱，所有他們家附近的游泳池都從四月底就不對外開放，推知男子說That’s too pathetic（那太可憐了）的意思為(A)。(B)沒什麼大不了的、(C)現在還太早，皆非合適的答案。故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: This way, Helen. Tom lives on the third floor. Let’s climb the stairs.
W: Oh, the stairs are so small. This apartment building must be very old.
M: Yeah, it’s at least fifty years old. Be careful! There are some small boxes on the stairs.
W: Hey, it’s not right to put the boxes here. Ouch! My right foot hurts!
M: What happened? Let me see. Oh, no, it’s a nail.
W: Argh! Poor me!
Q: How are the stairs to Tom’s home?
questions.e: 男子和女子正在爬樓梯拜訪住在三樓的朋友，樓梯已經很小還堆置雜物，女子又不小心踩到釘子，推知樓梯很危險，選(B)。(A)它們很大、(C)它們很方便，皆非合適的答案。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
B: What does your father do, Linda?
G: He draws and writes comics.
B: Cool! He must love his job very much.
G: Yeah, he does. However, he has little time for himself or for us.
B: You mean that he spends a lot of time working?
G: That’s it. He has to look for comic ideas all the time. Also, he must work very hard to keep his works fresh and interesting.
B: Oh, I see.
Q: What does the girl think of her father’s job?
o: He puts all his heart into it.
questions.e: 女孩的父親從事漫畫工作，忙到沒有時間給自己和家人，並且必須不斷地找靈感，推知她認為她父親全心全意地投入工作，選(C)。(A)相當簡單、(B)他沒有真的很喜歡，皆非合適的答案。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Are you free this Saturday afternoon, Lisa?
W: Yes, I am. What’s up?
M: Well, I’d like to invite you and David to my new house around 2 p.m.. I moved in last weekend.
W: Good. We’ll be there.
M: I live at 45, Second Street. When you get to Beach Road, drive along, and turn right at Second Street. Go for two blocks, and you’ll see my house on your left.
W: Got it.
Q: Where does the man live?（選項見圖）
questions.e: 根據男子的住家路徑指示，他的家在Second Street 45號。開車由Beach Road直走，在Second Street右轉，前行兩個街區，就可看到他的住家在左側。參照地圖，推知(C)正確標注他的住家位置。故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Today’s the first Wednesday of April. It’s also National Walking Day.
M: Really? What’s the holiday for?
W: Taking time to enjoy walking, of course. At least 30 minutes a day.
M: Come on, in this busy, modern world, who has so much time for walking?
W: I do. When going to work, I usually get off the bus two stops earlier, so I can walk to my office. Believe me, it’s good for health in the long run.
M: Well, I’ll start to walk more when I have time.
W: When?
M: Umm…
Q: What can we learn from the dialogue?
o: The woman invites the man to go for a walk.
The man does not enjoy walking as much as the woman does.
Both the man and the woman usually take a walk in the morning.
questions.e: 女子藉由國際走路日鼓勵男子多走路。女子自己上班都會提早兩站下車以能多走路。男子則是一再以忙碌為藉口，沒有什麼興趣想多走路，推知男子對走路沒有女子興致來的高，選(B)。(A)女子邀請男子去散步、(C)男子和女子通常在早上都會散步，皆非合適的答案。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Tony’s already three. It’s time to teach him to read more.
W: Yeah, I just thought about it last night. What should we do first?
M: Buy more picture books for him.
W: Maybe later. He already has at least one hundred books, dear.
M: Oh, I see. How about giving him a reading corner?
W: Great idea. The corner next to the sofa will be OK.
M: Agreed. Let’s take away the boxes and bags.
W: OK. Let’s do it right now.
M: Good. After we finish, I’ll mop the floor.
Q: What are the man and the woman going to do first?
questions.e: 男子和女子想要為小孩加強閱讀，目前家中已有足夠的圖畫書，所以要優先布置閱讀角落，男子建議先搬走箱子和袋子，接著他會拖地，推知他們要先搬走一些東西，選(B)。(A)拖地、(C)採購圖畫書，皆非合適的答案。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: This umbrella looks good. How much is it?
M: $1,499.
W: $1,499! Um, maybe I don’t really need an umbrella now. Thank you.
M: Wait. It’s raining, and you’ll need an umbrella. Look at these two umbrellas. They’re on sale. The green one costs $399, and the yellow one, $599. Which do you like?
W: Let me look at them carefully. Hmm, not bad. Both are good, but I like the color yellow better.
M: Hmm, you have an eye for umbrellas.
Q: How much is the woman going to spend on a new umbrella?
questions.e: 女子原本看上的那把雨傘要價1,499元，她嫌太貴。後來男子介紹給她兩把特價的雨傘，綠色的399元，黃色的599元，女子看上黃色那一把，推知她將花599元買把新傘，選(B)。(A)$399元、(C)$1,499，皆非合適的答案。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（廣播提示音）W: Good afternoon, everyone. This is Green Town Station. We need to let you know that Train 1891 from River Town to White Beach is running late. This is because of the strong wind and the heavy rain in Rainbow Town. The train has to stop at Spring Town Station for now. When the weather gets better, the train will leave for Rainbow Town Station, and then arrive at Green Town Station. Before then, please wait for around 20 minutes.
Q: Which is the correct order of the stops for Train 1891?
o: River Town→Rainbow Town→Spring Town→Green Town→White Beach.
River Town→Spring Town→Rainbow Town→Green Town→White Beach.
River Town→Spring Town→Green Town→Rainbow Town→White Beach.
questions.e: 這則廣播發生的地點是在Green鎮車站。1891列車從River鎮行駛到White海灘，因為Rainbow鎮風雨大，火車暫時停靠在Spring鎮站，待天氣狀況改善，才繼續開往Rainbow鎮站，接著到Green鎮站，推知該列車行駛各站的順序應為(B)。故選(B)。
